gaps.sentence: He stole the pens and got away ___ it.
gaps.explanation: get away with something = do wrong without being punished.

gaps.sentence: They set ___ to climb the north face in April.
gaps.explanation: set out (to do) = begin a job/mission with a goal.

gaps.sentence: The bonus made up ___ all the overtime we had done.
gaps.explanation: make up FOR something = compensate for it.

gaps.sentence: This old house needs doing ___ before winter.
gaps.explanation: do up = repair and decorate a building. (British usage)

gaps.sentence: Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.

gaps.sentence: We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.

gaps.sentence: The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
